elaine: Hey team — auditor_jane asked for a compact SLO/audit checklist + chain-of-custody for KMS keys used by inference-prod. Can we confirm what we can hand over by tomorrow?

mike: quick answer: we can provide key metadata, rotation history, and signed access logs. need to confirm retention slices for the logs.

raj: fyi the KV-store that holds key references is in the control-plane cluster; actual envelope keys live in KMS (aws-kms).

auditor_jane: thanks — for SOC2 fieldwork we need (1) proof of key ownership and rotation timeline, (2) audit logs linking access to SAs, and (3) a sampling plan for log exports. also want a short playbook for emergency key rotation.

elaine: plan: 1) generate a key provenance manifest (signed) with key ARNs, created/rotated timestamps, and authorized principals. 2) export CloudTrail subset + KMS Audit events for the last 90 days (sampled by incident windows). 3) produce a small playbook doc ``/ops/rotation-playbook.md`` + a 1-page timeline PDF.

mike: command to export CloudTrail events (sample):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efg --start-time 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-03-31T23:59:59Z --max-results 50 > /tmp/kms-sample.json
```

raj: we'll also attach the role-binding snapshots from the control-plane at the same tick to show which service accounts were bound. I can produce `rbac-snapshot-2025-03-31.tar.gz`.

auditor_jane: for the sampling plan — prefer stratified windows: 2 business-critical deploy windows, 5 random normal days, and any incident-associated windows. that should be enough to validate controls.

elaine: sounds good. I'll (a) assemble the manifest, (b) kick the cloudtrail export job (mike take over if needed), (c) ask sec-bot to generate signed artifact checksums, (d) upload to the auditor bucket with presigned links.

sec-bot: artifact-export queued: export_id=exp-20250315-42. ETA ~6m. Checksums will be attached. :white_check_mark:

mike: exported a 90d sample to s3://redwood-audits/auditor_jane/exp-20250315-42/kms-sample.json.gz. perm=auditor_jane@external.redwood. Presigned links expire in 7 days.

elaine: attaching the playbook snippet: "If a key is compromised: 1) generate ephemeral key in staging, 2) create new envelope key in KMS, 3) rewrap artifacts, 4) rotate service account bindings, 5) trigger canary inference traffic, 6) notify GRC and rotate certs." Keep it short.

raj: added RBAC snapshot: s3://redwood-audits/auditor_jane/exp-20250315-42/rbac-snapshot-2025-03-31.tar.gz (md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e).

auditor_jane: perfect — can you also include the signed KMS key policy and ACL proof (who approved creation) for the oldest rotation entry? we need an approver audit trail.

elaine: yes — we'll include the approval ticket link and the signed approval from the key owner. linking to internal ticket RED-2456.

mike: one caveat: logs older than 365 days are archived to Glacier; if you want >1y we need a retrieval job (cost/time).

auditor_jane: not needed for this engagement, 90 days plus rotation trail is fine. please include short notes about retention policy and where long-term archives live.

elaine: will do. final deliverables expected within 24h: manifest (signed), cloudtrail sample (gz), rbac snapshot (tar.gz), playbook (md+pdf), approval links, and checksums.

sec-bot: export completed: exp-20250315-42. artifacts: kms-sample.json.gz, rbac-snapshot-2025-03-31.tar.gz, playbook-rot.pdf, manifest-signed.json. All uploads verified.

auditor_jane: thanks team — I'll review tonight and flag any gaps. appreciate the quick turnaround :handshake:
